name: Linear A Tablet Corpus
notes: Roughly 1,400-1,500 inscribed objects, ~7,300-7,400 signs total (Linear A Digital Corpus, J.G. Younger). Underlying Minoan language unclassified; Anatolian/Luwian, Semitic, and other hypotheses lack consensus. A 2026 unpublished, non-peer-reviewed "AI-assisted Semitic decipherment" claim (Tom Di Mino) is circulating and is explicitly treated with skepticism by specialists at Rutgers/Cambridge reviewing it — flagged as NOT changing decipherment_status from UNDECIPHERED.
